summary.answer: Builds the heal-cooldown HUD. State-condition closures, powerRatio/shader links, input-source updates and close hook are conditional callbacks. Flare/pulse Full states test powerRatio==1; the KBM ability prompt is true only on the explicit ability branch. Parent state/ammo callbacks can play Pulse when PowerBased and ShouldPulseNewAmmo. The tail registers close, conditionally calls PostLoadFunc and returns. Creates self via LUI.UIElement.new, LED via LUI.UIImage.new, AmmoWidgetAbilityContainer via CoD.AmmoWidget_AbilityContainer.new, AmmoWidgetMPAbilityFlare via CoD.AmmoWidgetMP_Ability_Flare.new, BackingFillAnim via LUI.UIImage.new, FullBackingDeployed via LUI.UIImage.new, AbilityPulse via CoD.AmmoWidgetMP_Ability_Flash.new, Box via LUI.UIImage.new, PowerBasedImageAvailable via LUI.UIImage.new, PowerBasedImageUnavailable via LUI.UIImage.new, NotAvailable via CoD.AmmoWidget_EquipmentEmpty.new, Line via LUI.UIImage.new, HeroAbilityUseString via CoD.ControllerDependent_TextBox.new, GlowRing via LUI.UIImage.new, FlareBack via LUI.UIImage.new, BountyHealthCount via CoD.BountyHunterHealthCount.new, CodCasterLoadoutSelection via CoD.CodCasterLoadoutSelectionHeal.new. Stores state predicates Full, Full, Hidden, KeyboardAndMouse, KeyboardAndMouseAbility, KeyboardAndMouseUltimate, KeyboardAndMouseScoreStreak, Hidden, InUse, Deployed, BountyEmpty, PowerBasedEmptyCharging, PowerBasedCharging, PowerBased; their body effects require state-system evaluation.
